newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse trade boosted by bond market.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse trade boosted by bond market.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index closed slightly higher on Friday in trade boosted by the bond market, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 502.47, up from 501.68 on Thursday.
Total volume was 8.49 million dinars against 2.172 million dinars. Turnover was 7.533 million dinars on the bond market and 707,753 on the first market.
BTEI bank, which on Friday reported higher net profits for 1996, was up 0.5 dinar to 23.5 dinars. Chemical Alkimia which also announced higher profits for 1996, was unchanged at 45 dinars.
Retail stores Monoprix rose 0.5 dinar to 36.
Banque de l'Habitat was down 0.43 dinar to 19.99.
